class.name: NNHTNNodes
class.brief_description: Base class for Hierarchical Task Network (HTN) domain nodes.
class.description: Shared base node for [NNHTNCompoundTask], [NNHTNMethod], [NNHTNTask], [NNHTNSubtaskCall], and [NNHTNParallelTask]. Provides preconditions ([member conditions] and [method on_check_preconditions]), replanning dependency hints ([member dependency_keys]), and partial-order links ([member predecessors]). Planning hooks receive a read-only predicted world [code]state[/code] and [code]args[/code] dictionary and must not modify scene state.

method.name: on_check_preconditions
method.description: Optional planning hook for availability checks that [member conditions] cannot express. Called after [member conditions] pass, both during planning (against predicted [param state]) and before task execution ticks (against live state).

members.member: Boolean expressions that must all pass for this node to be available. Referenced blackboard keys automatically trigger replanning.

If [code]true[/code], tells the planner that [member dependency_keys] lists every blackboard key read by this node's script planning hooks, avoiding unnecessary replans on unrelated blackboard changes.
Blackboard keys read by this node's script planning hooks so changes to those keys trigger replanning. Keys used in [member conditions], bindings, or argument references are tracked automatically.
Sibling nodes under the same [NNHTNMethod] that must be planned before this node when the method uses [constant NNHTNMethod.PARTIAL_ORDER].
